description: URL of the Chama Town Council website page the project record was scraped from (either the CDF Tracker page or a Constituency page).
The CDF funding year the project relates to, as stated on the source page.
The project's listed number on the source page. Blank where the source page did not number that section of projects.

The project's name and description, combined into one field. The source text has no consistent separator between a project's name and its description, so these were kept together rather than split inaccurately.
example_value: CLASS ROOM BLOCK AT CHIKONTHA PRIMARY Construction of a 1x3 crb at Chikontha Primary School

description: The project's sector classification as listed on the source page (e.g. EDUCATION, HEALTH, WATER AND SANITATION).
The type of activity carried out for the project (e.g. Construction, Procurement, Drilling, Renovation).

The ward and/or site location of the project. Because the source page has no marker between one project's location and the next project's number/name, this field may also contain a fragment of the following project's leading text.
Project identifier as listed in the official Chama South Constituency Approved Community Projects PDF.
Full description of the approved CDF project.
Ward, or wards, the project serves. Some projects serve 'All Wards' rather than a single ward.
Approved CDF funding amount for the project, in Zambian Kwacha (ZMW).
Sector classification for the project as listed in the source PDF (e.g. ROADS, HEALTH, EDUCATION, TRADITION).
The CDF funding year the project was approved under.
The constituency the project falls under.
Name of the district, constituency, or ward the row describes. District and constituency rows are subtotals; ward rows are the individual areas within them.
Total 2022 census population for the area, overall and split by sex.
2022 census population classified as rural for the area, overall and split by sex.
2022 census population classified as urban for the area, overall and split by sex. Shown as '-' where the area has no urban population recorded.
data_type: text (formatted number, comma thousands separator, or '-')

description: Land area of the district, constituency, or ward, in square kilometres.
Population per square kilometre for the area.
Name of the council revenue line item or category subtotal, from the IDP's five-year financial plan.
Projected revenue for that line item in the given year, in Zambian Kwacha (ZMW).
